topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I can’t believe they just cut it down, without a single thought or warning. That tree wasn’t just any tree; it was a piece of my childhood, something I nurtured with my own hands, watched grow from a fragile sapling into a strong, sturdy tree. It was where I carved my initials, where I spent countless afternoons dreaming under its shade. Now, it’s just a stump. How could they? Didn’t they understand what it meant? I know I can’t change what’s done, but it’s hard to accept. I wish there was something, anything, I could do to bring it back.
